subject: journey/nautilus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. Seen from inside an 1860s submarine saloon, a dim blue-green wall of ice stands close outside the broad observation glass. On the other side a small helmeted crewman works on the thick ice floor by electric lamplight. Show cramped water-filled space between ice surfaces, muted cold colours.
